source: ../.ufo/watchdog.log (mutable; line text, not line numbers, is the evidence unit)
method: Parse latest timestamped launch per lane and any same-round complete at or after that launch; compare launch age against 2 * TICK_SECONDS (450 seconds in shokunin.conf).
boundary: Dispatch/complete-log snapshot only; no old report treated as new completion, no daemon status treated as liveness, no fleet-wide closure judgment. No qualifying old launch existed at capture, so no progressing/silent classification was required.
